required: one H1 and one main landmark per page
all meaningful images have accurate alt text and decorative images use empty alt text
no horizontal overflow at 1440 and 390 pixels
no broken local links or assets
no console errors, page errors, or failed requests
visible focus states and reduced-motion behavior
functional calls to action with a clear next step
visible concept, rights, affiliation, and unknown-fact disclosures
desktop and phone screenshots plus content hashes

campaign_identity_gate.rule: The public Lab may explain process, evidence, and capability, but it may not soften or replace the campaign thesis that made the concept distinctive.

creative_reject_conditions: The concept could fit an unrelated business after swapping the name.
Directions differ only by color, image, or minor component arrangement.
Display typography is only generic bold, color, or italic styling rather than a composed visual layer.
Backgrounds and containers lack subject-native pattern, texture, material, or depth.
A direction reads as a campaign poster rather than a complete usable website.
An official mark, mascot, person, affiliation, or endorsement is copied or implied without authority.
The call to action, information architecture, or mobile reading order is unclear.
A pristine form shows an error state, a rail hides content without controls, or text overlaps or breaks inside words.

speed_policy.observed_golden_window_scope: first paid image job accepted through final passing browser QA for the one-direction AND IF IT IS social-presence baseline
speed_policy.rule: Missing the time target creates a latency finding; it does not authorize shipping work below the quality floor. Noncritical polish moves to selected-direction refinement.

required_on_reuse: subject-native typography, pattern, texture, and symbolism
reuse_policy.forbidden: Wholesale cloning of a prior customer or proof site.
